usedFor: ThriveCart holds checkouts and orders, and Slack tells the team with “Send Message” after “Product Is Purchased”.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Is Purchased” in ThriveCart, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each sale shows up in a channel, so the team hears about it as it happens.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval today, so “Send Message” will not post until you approve.
